regime_context: The policy regime is low-real-yield engineering plus strategic re-industrialization, but the revealed intent is now inflation-mandate first: Warsh holds the hawkish line while the labor leg cracks, keeping easing as post-midterm optionality. The consensus narrative treats tariff truces and ceasefires as durable de-escalation; revealed interest runs the other way — defense/energy/onshoring bids persist regardless of headline truces.
regime_context_zh: 当前政策体制是低实际收益率操作加战略再工业化，但已显露的真实意图是通胀目标优先：沃什在就业数据走弱时仍维持鹰派立场，把宽松留作中期选举后的选择性工具。市场共识把关税休战和停火视为持久的去升级，而真实利益指向相反——防务、能源和本土化供应链的买盘不因头条休战而消退。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: The Fed under Warsh is front-loading credibility via a hike-majority path (>70% Sept), with real 10y at ~2.29% and a stagflationary split (hot PCE + weak payrolls) that keeps the inflation mandate primary. Treasury's bill-heavy issuance suppresses front-end yields but does not rescue long duration.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什治下的美联储通过市场对9月加息概率超过70%的定价来前置建立信誉，10年期实际利率约2.29%，滞胀分化（PCE偏热、就业偏弱）使通胀目标优先级不变。财政部以国库券为主的发行压低了前端收益率，但救不了长久期。
evidence: CME FedWatch moved to >70% probability of a Sept hike (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp)
May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y; headline 4.1% y/y — highest since Oct-2023
Treasury bill-heavy issuance + buybacks + dealer-intermediation reform explicitly target front-end yield suppression
Warsh's Sintra response (7/1) held hawkish line: 'prices are too high'
theses.dissent: A genuine labor-market crack (June payrolls +57k, participation 61.5% at 4-year low) could force a data-driven September pivot, and long duration would front-run that cut.
theses.dissent_zh: 若就业市场真正恶化（6月非农仅+57k，劳动参与率61.5%创4年新低），可能迫使美联储以数据驱动方式在9月转向，长久期资产将提前抢跑降息交易。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 3% before the 60-day check-by date

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse and US strikes re-primed the energy rotation that was already Q1's top ETF-inflow sector. The administration needs oil upside as part of its stagflationary FX bridge without breaking the dollar — energy equities capture that without direct commodity exposure.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂与美国打击重新点燃了能源板块轮动，该板块本就是Q1 ETF资金流入第一的行业。政府需要油价上行作为滞胀汇率桥梁的一部分，同时不破坏美元——能源股在不直接暴露大宗商品的情况下捕捉这一点。
evidence: Ceasefire declared over 7/8 (Trump), US strikes on Iran 7/8–11, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years) on the conflict
Prior record: two XLE overweight calls hit (realized +4.7%, +2.5%)
theses.dissent: A ceasefire re-announcement or Hormuz transit normalization could unwind the risk premium as fast as it built; oil headline-fragility is two-sided.
theses.dissent_zh: 再次宣布停火或霍尔木兹海峡通行正常化，可能让风险溢价像积累时一样快速消退；油价对头条的脆弱性是双向的。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the 45-day check-by date

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: Treasury's dealer-intermediation reform and eSLR-reform progress are structural tailwinds for dealer banks; a steeper curve with front-end yield suppression is the exact environment that boosts net interest margins for regional lenders.
theses.thesis_zh: 财政部的交易商中介改革和eSLR改革进展是交易商银行的结构性顺风；前端收益率被压制而曲线变陡的环境，恰是提升区域银行净息差的条件。
evidence: Treasury under Bessent runs dealer-intermediation reform + explicit yield suppression via bill-heavy issuance
Concrete eSLR-reform progress is on the open-prediction ledger (a proposed or final rule from a banking regulator)
Front-end Treasuries (BIL/SHV) are a rotation target; dealer banks sit at the fulcrum
theses.dissent: A hike-majority Fed as of September would tighten funding conditions and hit regional bank credit quality before the reform benefits materialize.
theses.dissent_zh: 截至9月市场定价美联储大概率加息，这会收紧融资条件并在改革红利兑现前打击区域银行信贷质量。

falsifier.text: KBE lags SPY by 5% before the 90-day check-by date

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The advanced-chip tariff regime transition (Section 122 expiring July 24, Section 301 ~12.5% pending) plus the China tech-war truce creates two-sided supply-chain ambiguity. Revealed onshoring interest persists, but the recent SMH overweight miss (-15.8%) shows this proxy is sensitive to interim trade headlines.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税体制过渡（第122条7月24日到期，第301条约12.5%待定）叠加中美科技战休战，使供应链存在双向不确定性。本土化真实利益仍在，但最近一次做多SMH的失误（-15.8%）表明该代理对贸易头条高度敏感。
evidence: Section 122 expiring July 24 and the Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) pending — verify China effective tariff rate after July 24
SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind the tariff-protection premium
Prior record: SMH overweight missed at -15.78% realized
theses.dissent: A clean Section 301 handoff plus advanced-chip tariff expansion would re-anchor the onshoring bid and make semiconductors a high-conviction overweight again.
theses.dissent_zh: 若第301条顺利交接且先进芯片关税扩大，将重新锚定本土化买盘，使半导体重回高确信度的超配标的。
